[package]
name = "cc-server"
version.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true

[lib]
name = "cc_server"
path = "src/lib.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "codecortex"
path = "src/main.rs"

[dependencies]
cc-model = { path = "../cc-model" }
cc-db = { path = "../cc-db" }
cc-index = { path = "../cc-index" }
cc-search = { path = "../cc-search" }
clap.workspace = true
tokio.workspace = true
tracing.workspace = true
tracing-subscriber.workspace = true
serde.workspace = true
serde_json.workspace = true
# Preserve user TOML formatting when updating the Codex CLI installer entry.
# This version is already present in the workspace lockfile through cc-index.
toml_edit = "0.22.27"
rmcp.workspace = true
tokio-util = { version = "0.7", features = ["rt"] }
dirs.workspace = true
notify.workspace = true
regex.workspace = true
chrono.workspace = true
lru.workspace = true
# Optional semantic persistence seam (P6-002). Declared but unwired by
# default: the `semantic` feature is enabled explicitly; the default build
# neither compiles cc-semantic into cc-server nor creates any cache path.
cc-semantic = { path = "../cc-semantic", optional = true }
reqwest = { version = "0.12.28", default-features = false, features = ["blocking", "rustls-tls"], optional = true }

[features]
semantic = ["dep:cc-semantic"]
semantic-http = ["semantic", "dep:reqwest"]
p8-db-lock-observation = ["cc-db/p8-db-lock-observation"]

[dev-dependencies]
rmcp = { workspace = true, features = ["client", "transport-child-process"] }
# Tests seed the index DB with raw SQL through their own connections;
# production code reads exclusively through cc-db's typed facets.
rusqlite.workspace = true
tempfile = "3"
